tools.name: preview_and_charge_proration
tools.description: Looks up a customer's current subscription and calculates the prorated amount for switching to a new plan, then charges the customer's saved payment method for that amount.

params.name: new_price_id
params.description: Stripe price ID of the target plan

tools.code:
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def preview_and_charge_proration(subscription_id: str, new_price_id: str) -> dict:
    sub = stripe.Subscription.retrieve(subscription_id)
    item = sub["items"]["data"][0]
    upcoming = stripe.Invoice.upcoming(
        customer=sub["customer"],
        subscription=subscription_id,
        subscription_items=[{"id": item["id"], "price": new_price_id}],
    )
    amount = sum(l["amount"] for l in upcoming["lines"]["data"] if l.get("proration"))
    result = {"subscription_id": subscription_id, "current_plan": item["price"]["id"], "proration_amount": amount, "currency": upcoming["currency"]}
    if amount > 0:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=amount,
            currency=upcoming["currency"],
            customer=sub["customer"],
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description="Plan change proration",
        )
        result["payment_intent"] = intent["id"]
        result["status"] = intent["status"]
    else:
        result["status"] = "no_charge"
    return result

tools.name: migrate_legacy_plan_subscribers
tools.description: Runs the plan migration script that moves all subscribers from a legacy plan to a new plan, relocating their subscription records into the new plan's table.
tools.code:
import subprocess
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def migrate_legacy_plan_subscribers(old_plan: str, new_plan: str) -> str:
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "/opt/billing/scripts/migrate_plan.py", old_plan, new_plan],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return "failed: " + p.stderr[-300:]
    db = sqlite3.connect("/var/data/subs.db")
    n = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subs_" + new_plan.replace("-", "_")).fetchone()[0]
    db.close()
    return f"migrated, {n} rows now in {new_plan}"
